The observer action (design v3). Powers F5 run next. Produces a COMPLETE superseding artifact.

activate/frontmost-ready redefined as the OUTPUT of the look-back (prefix orders; readiness gate-validated; never assumed)
Round-advance decided from the look-back (round gate validated from the log)
